create.name: Richard Gordon
create.bio:
Richard Gordon is an American energy-work teacher and author, and the founder of Quantum-Touch. In the early 1970s he studied therapeutic massage, spiritual healing and herbalism at the Christos School of Natural Healing in Taos, New Mexico, where he first became aware of life-force energy in his hands. That led him to polarity therapy and to his first book, Your Healing Hands: The Polarity Experience. He then apprenticed with the energy worker Robert Rasmussen and took over his work on Rasmussen's retirement, developing it into the method he named Quantum-Touch.

Quantum-Touch combines breathing practices, body awareness and focused intention to build and direct life-force energy, and is taught as a simple skill that anyone can learn and use for themselves, family and friends. Richard's book Quantum-Touch: The Power to Heal is available in 17 languages, and the method is now taught by more than 150 certified instructors around the world. In his later work he explores the meeting point of matter and consciousness through simple, repeatable experiments. He teaches online, including courses on The Shift Network on Quantum-Touch and on states of expanded awareness he calls super-consciousness.

books.title: Quantum-Touch: The Power to Heal (Third Edition)
books.author: Richard Gordon
books.description: Richard Gordon's founding guide to Quantum-Touch, now in its third edition. It explains the method's breathing and body-awareness techniques for building and directing life-force energy, and the ideas of resonance and vibration behind them.

books.title: Your Healing Hands: The Polarity Experience
books.author: Richard Gordon
books.description: Richard's first book, an illustrated primer on polarity therapy written before he developed Quantum-Touch. It shows step by step how to give a full polarity session and how to work with the body's energy field to restore balance.

courses.title: Super-Consciousness With Quantum-Touch®
courses.description: A twelve-module self-paced Shift Network course taught by Richard Gordon with Tyler Odysseus and Deborah Gair. It uses Quantum-Touch and other energy techniques to connect with the innermost Self and move beyond limiting beliefs into an expanded state of awareness.

courses.title: Quantum-Touch Original Workshop Online
courses.description: A video library of the original Quantum-Touch Level 1 workshop, taught by Richard Gordon in 2002, with nearly five hours of instruction. It covers the breathing and sweeping techniques, energy patterns, chakras, toning and distant work, plus a bonus module on perceiving energy.

sprint.tier_evidence: No personal accounts found; Quantum-Touch company accounts: YouTube @QuantumTouch 23.4K subscribers (channel page, 30 Oct 2026); Instagram @quantumtouchinc 6,472 (og:description); Facebook /quantumtouch 17,787 (og:description); X @quantumtouch count could not be read → ~47.7k → local_hero
flags: Tier likely undersells his reach: his book is a bestseller in 17 languages and two interviews have 197k and 383k views, but all social counts are for the Quantum-Touch company (CEO Jennifer Taylor); no personal accounts found.
The email (mail@quantumtouch.com) is the Quantum-Touch company address, not Richard's personal one; the contact page also lists jennifer@quantumtouch.com (the CEO).
Only one photo confirmed (Shift Network headshot, 300 px); the Quantum-Touch 'Our Story' photo shows him with a client (two people) and the YouTube avatar is a logo.

Strict health-claim rule removed most of his work: the Quantum-Touch method is widely marketed for pain relief and posture correction. Kept items have neutral titles and descriptions, but the Quantum-Touch website itself mentions pain relief; a human may want to review whether linking it is acceptable.
Kept book 'Quantum-Touch: The Power to Heal' and video of the same name: title promises healing in general (no condition named); borderline.
Super-Consciousness is co-taught with Tyler Odysseus and Deborah Gair; Tyler Odysseus is also in this sprint (rank 120), so the course may appear on both plans; Deborah Gair is not in the queue.
left_out: Shift courses left out for health claims: Energy Healing With Quantum-Touch (both the self-paced version and the live version that started 15 Oct 2026; pages promise to reduce pain and inflammation and correct posture); Advanced Energy Healing With Quantum-Touch (same claims); Reversing Aging With Quantum-Touch (title).

Books left out: Quantum-Touch 2.0 - The New Human (blurb: reduce pain in minutes, work on multiple conditions); The Secret Nature of Matter (blurb lists nerve pain, headaches, back pain, TMJ); Supercharging Quantum-Touch and Quantum-Touch Core Transformation (by Alain Herriott, Richard wrote only the foreword; blurbs name immune disorders and chronic pain).
Quantum-Touch Levels 1-5 workshops and Art of Youthing Online: taught by other instructors (and Art of Youthing is an ageing claim).
Free Quantum-Touch class (Energy Boost): page promises to boost the immune system.
Self-Created Health (video and system): framed around the emotional causes of health problems.

Videos left out: Chiropractor Session; Can Quantum-Touch Heal Me?; Healing in Real Time; immune-system tips; pendant product videos; Meet Your Inner Healer (other speakers lead); Shift Network livestreams (hub); 'Healing Yourself and Others' (Crane Factor) and 'Validates the Power of Love and Intention' interviews (over the 12-video cap).
